about: Numbers the election calendar and voting dates use, each tagged SOURCED, ESTIMATED (with its source and spread) or TUNABLE (with the spread it's checked against). Read by src/core2/term-rules.ts.

pollsOpenMinuteOfDay.source: National Conference of State Legislatures, 'State Poll Opening and Closing Times': polling places open between 6 a.m. and 8 a.m. local time, most commonly 7 a.m. The minute of the day the Election Day stop is set at.
